summary: The proposal has all major required sections, two referenced diagrams including an activity diagram, action-form objectives, and a specific first-person AI statement with tool purposes and review confirmation. However, it needs substantial revision: the bibliography has only five publications, the Problem and Motivation sections exceed their length limits and partly repeat each other, the overall text is longer than the recommended range, the AI statement does not identify proposal sections, and the schedule contains an excluded documentation task, a vague final deliverable, and dates that precede the stated thesis start. Several writing issues also require correction, including prohibited sentence starters, passive voice, and an initially undefined abbreviation.

findings.title: Bibliography Below Minimum
findings.description: The bibliography contains only five publication entries, below the required minimum of 6–8 peer-reviewed publications. Add at least one (preferably several) relevant peer-reviewed sources and cite them where they support the proposal.

findings.title: Motivation Exceeds Length Limit
